message:
vc_obj2tifxyz: fail instead of writing an empty tifxyz when no grid point rasterizes

Closes #1320. With normalised UVs and the default stretch factor the tool rasterized 0 of 4 grid points, wrote a 2x2 tifxyz made only of the -1 sentinel, printed «Successfully converted» and exited 0. It now prints an error naming the grid size and the two ways out (a stretch factor, or --uv-to-obj), writes nothing and exits 1. The usage line no longer calls the default UV-metric mode «legacy behavior».
